profile.name: JUMO Quantrol温度控制器
profile.description: 用于实验室温度调节与监测的温度控制器，可读取当前温度、设定值、加热输出占空比和加热器开关状态，并支持任务准备、测量、停止和复位等控制操作。
profile.description_en: A temperature controller for laboratory temperature regulation and monitoring. It can read the current temperature, setpoint, heater output duty cycle, and heater on/off state, and supports task preparation, measurement, stopping, and reset operations.

rows.profile_value: 用于实验室温度调节与监测的温度控制器，可读取当前温度、设定值、加热输出占空比和加热器开关状态，并支持任务准备、测量、停止和复位等控制操作。

A temperature controller for laboratory temperature regulation and monitoring. It can read the current temperature, setpoint, heater output duty cycle, and heater on/off state, and supports task preparation, measurement, stopping, and reset operations.
